deflator.source: Reserve Bank of India Table 165, CPI Combined All India General Index; source NSO/MoSPI
deflator.caveat: General CPI is a transparent common-price-basis research deflator, not a power-sector-specific escalation index.

ksebl_weighted_average_purchase_fy2023_2.source: KSERC truing-up evidence quoting KSEBL weighted average power purchase cost FY2023-24
ksebl_weighted_average_purchase_fy2023_2.boundary_warning: Annual weighted power-purchase accounting, not interval landed Kerala-periphery price.

iex_dam_fy2023_24.source: Indian Energy Exchange FY2023-24 annual reporting / investor financials
iex_dam_fy2023_24.boundary_warning: Exchange MCP excludes Kerala-specific transmission charges, losses, fees, DSM and contract obligations.
iex_dam_fy2023_24.source_note: IEX investor page lists Annual Report FY 2023-24; the report states FY24 DAM average price was Rs 5.24/unit.

downstream_bulk_supply_stress_fy2023_24.source: KSERC order reporting FY2023-24 average power purchase cost for a Kerala bulk-supply licensee purchasing from KSEBL
downstream_bulk_supply_stress_fy2023_24.boundary_warning: Downstream bulk-supply cost includes a different delivery/accounting boundary and is not Kerala-border import cost.

transfer_evidence.source: Central Electricity Authority Resource Adequacy Plan for Transmission System of Kerala up to 2034-35
interpretation: 2696 MW and 2020 MW are peak load-generation-balance import requirements in the CEA planning cases, not published future ATC values.
MVA and circuit-km additions cannot be arithmetically converted to statewide ATC without power-flow/contingency studies.
v1.0 therefore keeps 4455 MW as the only source-valued ATC cap and preserves 80%/60% stress sensitivities; it does not invent a higher 2030 ATC.
